Oh snap, I just posted a version of this in a different thread:

Ingredients:

-garlic

-olive oil

-2-cup bag of shredded mozzarella

-1 lb. ground beef (chicken also works)

-metric fuckton of kale (or spinach if you want)

-jar of pizza sauce

-salt, pepper

-oregano

-mushrooms and any other toppings you want

  1. Heat up some olive oil and garlic in a cast iron skillet
  2. Once the skillet is hot, chuck in your ground beef. Try to get it to sear a bit if possible. Season it with some salt and pepper
  3. Add mushrooms
  4. Start preheating your oven to 350-375 degrees
  5. Once the beef is mostly browned, stir as much kale in there as possible. Keep adding more as it wilts. Apply olive oil as necessary. Season with pepper and some salt as you go.
  6. Once the kale is all wilted in there, turn off your burner, dump the pizza sauce on top, and spread it around. Give it a light dusting of oregano.
  7. Dump the whole bag of mozzarella on top to counteract the healthiness of the forest of kale you just added. Spread it around, but try to keep it away from the edges of the skillet.
  8. Stick the skillet in the oven until the top of the cheese is golden and crispy. It should be done around 25-30 minutes.
